text: Training Objective Through one academic year (Fall and Spring Semesters, totally 36 weeks) of study, students can reach HSK 5-6 in Chinese Proficiency Test and pass College Entrance Examination. Courses offered 30 class hours per week, one cultural practice per week. Condition of Completion Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion from School of International Education of Beijing Union University. Application Period All year around.
